simple.meaning: קָטָן (qâṭân) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “abbreviated , i.e. diminutive , literally (in quantity, size or number) or figuratively (in age or importance).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 101 times across Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Judges, and 18 more, beginning at Genesis 1:16. Its contexts include family, family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קָטָן (H6996).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
